synthesizedFacts.fact: Moisturizers are essential for maintaining skin hydration and can prevent water loss from the skin.
Ceramides are crucial for repairing the skin barrier, especially in dry skin.
Occlusives, emollients, and humectants are key ingredients in effective moisturizers for dry skin.
Moisturizers should be chosen based on skin type: gels for oily skin, creams for dry skin, and lotions for normal skin.
Fragrance-free products are recommended for sensitive skin to avoid irritation.
